tenille arts.bio: Weyburn, Saskatchewan singer-songwriter Tenille Arts is a Canadian country artist whose melodic, contemporary songwriting has produced platinum-certified singles and a growing international career.

tenille townes.bio: Grande Prairie, Alberta singer-songwriter Tenille Townes is an award-winning Canadian country artist known for vivid storytelling, intimate vocals and self-produced, emotionally direct songwriting.

teon gibbs.bio: Vancouver-based artist Teon Gibbs blends R&B, soul and hip-hop with smooth vocals, relatable writing and community-building work through his 100 Collective platform.

tia wood.bio: Saddle Lake Cree Nation singer-songwriter Tia Wood is a Plains Cree and Coast Salish Canadian artist whose soulful pop and R&B carries the musical traditions and contemporary experiences of her community.

timbuktu.bio: London, Ontario-born, Toronto-based rapper and producer Timbuktu is a veteran of Canadian underground hip-hop whose work spans solo releases, Backburner and groups including Swamp Thing and Teenburger.

tona.bio: Toronto rapper Tona is a veteran Canadian MC known for densely written underground hip-hop, independent releases and collaborations with producers and lyricists across the country's rap scene.

tone mason.bio: Toronto production team Tone Mason makes hip-hop and R&B built around sample-based production, drum programming and songwriting, with credits spanning Canadian music, film and television.

tre mission.bio: Toronto rapper and producer Tre Mission is a Canadian grime pioneer whose music connects North American hip-hop with the U.K. grime scene through rapid-fire lyricism and bass-heavy production.

tyler shaw.bio: Vancouver-born Chinese-Canadian singer-songwriter and producer Tyler Shaw makes polished pop built around melodic hooks, romantic songwriting and a string of platinum-certified Canadian singles.

töme.bio: Montréal-born Nigerian-French Canadian singer-songwriter TÖME blends alternative R&B, Afrobeats and pop in a global-facing catalogue that has earned Juno recognition.
